# Getting started

Install the client with `pip install miniclient`.

## Connect

Use `Client` and `select_graph()` to open a graph.

```python
from miniclient import Client

db = Client(host="localhost", port=6379)
g = db.select_graph("social")
g.query("CREATE (:Person {name: 'Ann'})")
```

## Read-only queries

Use `Graph.ro_query` for reads. See [Connect](#connect).

<Note>
Read-only queries never write.
</Note>

```python
result = g.ro_query("MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name")
print(result)
```

## Listing graphs

`list_graphs()` returns every graph name.
